message_observed_by_owner: Failed to allocate directory watch: Too many open files

classification.maps_to: fs.inotify (instances and/or watches), not open file table exhaustion

visible_to_uid_1001_only.note: root/system unit inotify consumers are not readable without elevated access; host-wide consumer of the 128-instance budget not fully enumerated

journal_around_09_48_utc.reason: journalctl requires adm/systemd-journal; current user sees no entries

risk.why: max_user_instances=128 is low for a multi-unit host; Path/Directory watches from systemd can fail intermittently while ExecStart still succeeds

remediation_persist: echo fs.inotify.max_user_instances=512 | sudo tee /etc/sysctl.d/99-inotify-instances.conf && sudo sysctl --system
